newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PHILIPS LAUNCHES DVD PLAYER IN U.S..
newsitem.headline: PHILIPS LAUNCHES DVD PLAYER IN U.S..

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Thursday it had introduced its first digital video disc (DVD) player in the U.S. and was planning a DVD rental programme with PolyGram Video.
Philips said in a statement its Magnavox 400AT player will be available through U.S. retailers at a suggested retal price of $549.

DVD discs are based on a similar technology to compact discs but permit the storage of much more digital information, allowing them to contain high quality video and audio material such as feature length films.
PolyGram , Philips' 75 percent owned music and movies unit, will make available DVD titles such as "Fargo", "Four Weddings and a Funeral" and "Dead Man Walking," through U.S. video stores in June.
Philips said it planned to launch DVD video players in Europe and Asia Pacific this autumn.
